services.desc: Chase The Blue Tarpon charters are available between May through July, Tarpon fishing is not just a sport, it is a passion filled with excitement and challenge for anglers worldwide. These magnificent creatures are renowned for their beauty, size, acrobatic jumps, and impressive fighting abilities, making them a bucket list fish. Tarpon, often referred to as the "Silver King," hold a prestigious status as one of the most sought-after game fish globally. Their sheer power and tenacity make every encounter an unforgettable experience.
